style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Olive & Cone Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a touch of natural elegance to your home with this artificial 55cm olive & cone wreath. Featuring lifelike olive leaves and rustic pinecones, it combines soft greenery with earthy textures for a beautifully balanced, woodland-inspired display. Perfect for doors, walls, or mantelpieces, this wreath adds understated charm and a cosy feel to any space. Its neutral tones and realistic detailing make it versatile for both seasonal and everyday décor, complementing a variety of interior styles. Lightweight yet full of character, it’s easy to hang and designed to maintain its beauty year after year. Enhance your home with this 55cm olive and cone wreath—a timeless addition that brings natural charm indoors. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W55cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
